title: Plotting the Loss Curves of Model 1

cues.en: In the last video we did the really exciting thing of training our first model with data augmentation.
cues.zh: 上支影片做了很令人興奮的事：訓練第一個使用資料增強的模型。

cues.en: But we also saw that quantitatively it looks like that it didn't give us much improvement.
cues.zh: 但從數值上也看到，看來沒帶來多少改進。

cues.en: So let's keep evaluating our model here.
cues.zh: 繼續評估模型。

cues.en: I'm going to make a section recall that one of my favorite ways or one of the best ways, not just my favorite to evaluate the performance of a model over time is to plot the loss curves.
cues.zh: 我要建立一節；記得，我最喜歡的方法之一，或者說不只是我喜歡，也是隨時間評估模型表現最好的方法之一，就是畫損失曲線。

cues.en: So a lost curve helps you evaluate your model's performance over time, and it will also give you a
cues.zh: 損失曲線協助隨時間評估模型表現，也能提供

cues.en: great visual representation or a visual way to see if your model is under fitting or overfitting.
cues.zh: 很好的視覺表示，讓你看出模型欠擬合或過擬合。

cues.en: So let's plot the loss curves of Model One results and see what happens.
cues.zh: 所以畫 model_1_results 的損失曲線，看看結果。

cues.en: We're using this function we created before and oh my goodness, is that going in the right direction?
cues.zh: 使用之前建立的函數；哦，天啊，這有朝正確方向前進嗎？

cues.en: It looks like our test loss is going up here.
cues.zh: 看起來測試損失正在上升。

cues.en: Now, is that where we want it to go?
cues.zh: 這是想要的方向嗎？

cues.en: Remember, the ideal direction for a lost curve is to go down over time because loss is measuring what it's measuring how wrong our model is, and the accuracy curve looks like it's all over the place as
cues.zh: 記得，理想損失曲線應隨時間下降，因為損失衡量什麼？衡量模型錯得多嚴重；準確率曲線看來也到處

cues.en: well.
cues.zh: 亂跑。

cues.en: I mean, it's going up kind of, but maybe we don't have enough time to measure these things.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，有點上升，但或許觀察時間還不夠長。

cues.en: So an experiment that you could do is trying both of our models model zero and model one for more epochs and see if these loss curves flatten out.
cues.zh: 可以做的實驗，是把 model_0 和 model_1 都訓練更多週期，看看損失曲線能否趨平。

cues.en: So I'll pose you the question.
cues.zh: 我給你一個問題。

cues.en: Is our model under fitting or overfitting right now?
cues.zh: 現在模型欠擬合還是過擬合？

cues.en: Or both.
cues.zh: 還是兩者都有？

cues.en: So if we want to have a look at the loss curves, I'll just write is for the loss that is this is not for accuracy.
cues.zh: 看損失曲線時，我先寫這是針對損失，不是準確率。

cues.en: This is for loss.
cues.zh: 這是損失。

cues.en: Over time, we want it to go down.
cues.zh: 隨時間，希望它下降。

cues.en: So for me, our model is under fitting because our loss could be lower, but it also looks like it's overfitting as well.
cues.zh: 對我來說，模型欠擬合，因為損失還能更低；但看來也同時過擬合。

cues.en: So it's not doing a very good job because our test loss is far higher than our training loss.
cues.zh: 所以表現不太好，因為測試損失遠高於訓練損失。

cues.en: So if we go back to section four of the loan PyTorch audio book, what should an ideal loss curve look like?
cues.zh: 回到 learnpytorch.io 線上書籍第 4 章，理想的損失曲線應該是什麼樣子？

cues.en: I'd like you to start thinking of some ways that we could deal with overfitting of our model.
cues.zh: 希望你開始思考，有什麼方法能處理這個模型的過擬合。

cues.en: So could we get more data?
cues.zh: 能取得更多資料嗎？

cues.en: Could we simplify it?
cues.zh: 能簡化模型嗎？

cues.en: Could we use transfer learning?
cues.zh: 能用遷移學習嗎？

cues.en: We're going to see that later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會介紹。

cues.en: But you might want to jump ahead and have a look.
cues.zh: 不過你也許想先往前看看。

cues.en: And if we're dealing with unbefitting, what are some other things that we could try with our model, could we add some more layers, potentially another convolutional block?
cues.zh: 處理欠擬合時，又能對模型嘗試哪些方法？能增加層數，或許再加一個卷積區塊嗎？

cues.en: Could we increase the number of hidden units per layer?
cues.zh: 能增加每層隱藏單元數嗎？

cues.en: So we've got currently ten hidden units per layer.
cues.zh: 目前每層有 10 個隱藏單元。

cues.en: Maybe you want to increase that to 64 or something like that.
cues.zh: 也許想增為 64 之類。

cues.en: Could we train it for longer?
cues.zh: 能訓練更久嗎？

cues.en: That's probably one of the easiest things to try with our current training functions.
cues.zh: 對目前的訓練函數來說，這大概是最容易嘗試的方法之一。

cues.en: We could train for 20 epochs.
cues.zh: 可以訓練 20 個週期。

cues.en: So have a go with this reference this.
cues.zh: 試試看，參考這裡。

cues.en: Try out some experiments with.
cues.zh: 試一些實驗，

cues.en: See if you can get these lost curves more towards the ideal shape.
cues.zh: 看看能否讓損失曲線更接近理想形狀。

cues.en: And in the next video, we're going to keep pushing forward.
cues.zh: 下支影片繼續往下。

cues.en: We're going to compare our model results.
cues.zh: 要比較模型結果。

cues.en: So we've done two experiments.
cues.zh: 已經做了兩個實驗。

cues.en: Let's now see them side by side.
cues.zh: 現在並排看看。

cues.en: We've looked at our model results individually, and we know that they could be improved.
cues.zh: 已經各別查看模型結果，也知道還能改善。

cues.en: But a good way to compare all of the experiments is to compare your models results side by side.
cues.zh: 不過，比較所有實驗的好方法，是把模型結果並排比較。

cues.en: So that's what we're going to do in the next video.
cues.zh: 下支影片就來做。

cues.en: I'll see you there.
cues.zh: 到時見。
